resources.string: LijnCtrl gets departures straight from De Lijn\'s open data. For that you need your own free API key, which takes a couple of minutes to get.
Your saved API key can\'t be read any more (this happens after the phone\'s secure storage is reset). Paste it again to carry on. Your saved stops are still here.
Make a free account on De Lijn\'s developer portal, data.delijn.be.
Under Products, subscribe to the free Open Data product. One key covers both De Lijn APIs that LijnCtrl uses (departures and stop search).
Open your profile on the portal, copy the primary key, and paste it below.
Checked with De Lijn, then stored encrypted on this phone
Your key is only ever sent to api.delijn.be, over an encrypted connection. LijnCtrl has no servers of its own and collects nothing.
De Lijn doesn\'t accept this key. Check that you copied the whole primary key and that your subscription to the Open Data product is active.
This key works for stop search but not for departures (%1$s). Check that your subscription covers the Core API.
This key works for departures but not for stop search (%1$s). Check that your subscription covers the Search API.
De Lijn didn\'t accept your API key. Change it on the You page.
Your API key isn\'t allowed to do that. Check your subscription on data.delijn.be.
De Lijn doesn\'t know this stop or line any more
Too many requests to De Lijn right now. Wait a minute and try again.
De Lijn\'s servers are having trouble (error %1$d). Try again in a moment.
Can\'t reach De Lijn. Check your connection.
De Lijn took too long to answer
Blocked a request to %1$s: LijnCtrl only talks to De Lijn
Find a stop with Search or Nearby and tap its star. Your saved stops show up here with their next departures, live.
Nothing leaves from this stop in the next while. Late at night, or on lines that don\'t run today, that\'s normal.
Your own name for %1$s, like Home or Work. Leave it empty to use the stop\'s name.
Times in colour with the live mark come from the bus or tram\'s position. Others are the timetable.
Type a stop\'s name (\"Gent Korenmarkt\"), the number on its sign, a line number (\"T1\", \"71\") or a town to list all its stops.
LijnCtrl reads your location once, only when you ask, using Android\'s own location service (no Google services). It\'s only sent to De Lijn to find the stops around you, and never kept.
Turn on location in your phone\'s settings to find stops near you.
Your phone didn\'t get a location in time. Try again outside or near a window.
LijnCtrl uses your own key for De Lijn\'s open data, so nothing goes through anyone else\'s servers.
Your account and subscriptions on data.delijn.be
LijnCtrl can\'t show departures without it, so you\'ll be asked for a key again. Your saved stops stay.
LijnCtrl is free and open source. Sponsor development on GitHub
Found a problem or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub
Departures, stops and disruptions come from De Lijn\'s open data. LijnCtrl isn\'t made or endorsed by De Lijn.
Replaces the default colours with ones from your wallpaper
Departures refresh every 30 seconds while they\'re on screen. Times are Belgian time.
Ask for an app PIN (and optionally your fingerprint) when opening LijnCtrl. While locked, your API key stays encrypted with the PIN.
While LijnCtrl is locked, nothing is loaded and your API key is only stored encrypted with your PIN.
At least %1$d digits, separate from your phone\'s PIN
Only strong biometrics such as your fingerprint, checked by the phone\'s secure hardware. The PIN is still needed after a restart and every 72 hours.
Set up a fingerprint on this phone first
As soon as you leave the app
Screenshots and screen recordings show a blank screen
The recent apps view shows a blank card instead of the app
Couldn\'t unlock with your fingerprint. Use your PIN.
A fingerprint was added or removed. Unlock with your PIN, then turn fingerprint unlock on again.
Enter your PIN. It\'s needed after a restart and every 72 hours.
Too many tries. Try again in %1$d s
The PIN can\'t be recovered, because it encrypts your API key. LijnCtrl will remove the key and turn the app lock off; you\'ll need to paste your key again. Your saved stops and settings stay.
At least %1$d digits, different from your phone\'s PIN.
At least %1$d digits, different from your phone\'s PIN. If you forget it, you\'ll need to paste your API key again.
Enter your app PIN to turn the lock off.
Too easy to guess. Try a less obvious PIN.
The PINs didn\'t match. Start again.
Couldn\'t save the PIN. Try again.
Nothing is timetabled at this stop on this day, or for this line.
The badge next to a stop shows the next bus or tram heading there and when it\'s due, live where De Lijn tracks it.
Times in colour are live predictions for this trip; the others are the timetable.
De Lijn has no live data for this trip right now, so these are the timetable\'s times.
There are no De Lijn stops within %1$d metres of you. A larger distance can be set in Settings.
The map shows map tiles from OpenStreetMap (tile.openstreetmap.org), which sees the area you\'re looking at. Stops and departures still only come from De Lijn.
There are no De Lijn stops within 2 km of this place.
Places and addresses come from De Lijn\'s own search, the same as in its app.
Choose a stop, address or place
Planned by Transitous: every operator in Belgium, with live delays. The start and end of your route are sent to transitous.org. Change this in Settings.
Transitous found nothing for this time. Try another time or places a bit further apart.
LijnCtrl needs your location to plan from or to where you are.
Where you are when you plan
De Lijn doesn\'t have a position for this stop
Plan the route again on the Plan tab.
Planned on this phone from De Lijn\'s timetables. Tap a ride for live times.
Planned by Transitous (transitous.org) from open data of every Belgian operator.

Route planning and address search use Transitous (transitous.org), a free, open-source community service with every operator in Belgium (De Lijn, NMBS/SNCB, STIB/MIVB, TEC) and live delays. While this is on, the start and end of routes you plan, and the addresses and places you search for, are sent to Transitous. Stops, departures and everything else still come from De Lijn only.
For route planning and finding addresses and places
Transitous is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
Looking for an address or a place?
De Lijn can only search stops. Turn on Transitous to also find shops, landmarks and addresses (and to plan routes). What you type is then sent to transitous.org.
The last 15 from and to places you planned, kept on this phone only. Turning this off forgets them.
Shows where your bus or tram is right now on the trip map and the route map, from De Lijn\'s live vehicle feed. This needs a second, free key from De Lijn: the GTFS Realtime subscription.
Saved: buses and trams show live on the maps
Not set: tap to add one
A GTFS Realtime key is saved.

With this key, LijnCtrl shows where your bus or tram is right now: on a trip\'s map (the map button on a trip page) and on the route planner\'s map, with its line number and which way it\'s heading, updated every few seconds.
On data.delijn.be, open Products, subscribe to GTFS Realtime (free), and copy that subscription\'s primary key here. It\'s a different key from the one LijnCtrl already uses.

The key is only sent to De Lijn (api.delijn.be), the same as your main key, and is stored encrypted on this phone, sealed with your PIN while the app lock is on. While a map with live vehicles is open, LijnCtrl downloads De Lijn\'s live feed (about 250 KB) to find the vehicle, then asks for just that vehicle every 3 seconds.
De Lijn refused this GTFS Realtime key. Check that it\'s the key of an active GTFS Realtime subscription.
De Lijn\'s live feed is busy. Trying again shortly.
De Lijn\'s live feed answered with error %1$d
Add a GTFS Realtime key in Settings to see buses live
Looking for the bus on the road…
No live position for this bus right now

Routes are planned by Transitous (transitous.org), a free, open-source community planner with every operator in Belgium, trains included, and live delays. It receives the start and end of each route you plan, and also finds addresses and places for you. You can turn it off again in Settings.
Plan routes (trains included, with live delays) and find addresses and places. Where you plan to and what you search for is sent to transitous.org. Change this any time in Settings.
To see where your bus or tram is right now, subscribe to De Lijn\'s free GTFS Realtime product on the same portal and paste its key here. You can also add it later in Settings.
For "your bus is almost here", open a trip from your stop and tap the bell at the top: LijnCtrl watches that bus\'s live time and alerts you a few minutes before it arrives.
A notification when De Lijn reports a disruption on your saved stops or lines (checked every half hour)
Needs the app lock off: with it on, your key is sealed with your PIN and can\'t be read while the app is closed
The ongoing notification while LijnCtrl watches a bus for you
The alert when the bus you\'re watching is a few minutes away
New disruptions on your saved stops and lines
Get a notification when this bus is this many minutes from %1$s. LijnCtrl watches its live time until then.
You\'ll get a notification %1$d minutes before the bus arrives.
LijnCtrl needs permission to show notifications for alerts.
%1$s is %2$d min from %3$s. Time to go!
Couldn\'t find %1$s at %2$s any more, so the alert stopped.
Only the lines you tick are shown at this stop, here and on the Stops tab.
